title: Posol
profTagline: The web through another country's eyes. Pick a country and a service — the envoy brings back the page, the price or the search results as they are seen there.
installDesc: Opens like an app, from the home screen
installIosHint: In Safari: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
installGenericHint: In the browser menu choose Install or Add to Home Screen.
running: The envoy is on the way
failedWhy: The envoy came back without an answer: {why}
errUrl: A site address is needed, like example.com
errDomain: A domain is needed, like example.com
errBad: The envoy did not accept this value. Check it.
errNoExit: {country}: no live exit right now. Choose another country.
errBusy: Every envoy is out. Try again in a minute.
errAuth: Sign in to send the envoy.
errOffline: No connection. Check the network and try again.
errFailed: The envoy brought no answer. Try again or another country.
errCatalog: The catalog did not load. Check the connection.
